basis: Skeletal dysplasia and developmental disability define disease; hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Hormone resistance varies by subtype; nail morphology alone does not establish damage.
Fragile X syndrome subtype defined by neurodevelopmental impairment; no evidence establishes additional common organ damage.
Recessive carpal and tarsal osteolysis directly destroys bone; the supplied record does not establish common renal or other organ involvement.
Genetic subtype of immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; intestinal inflammation defines the condition.
Cortical malformation with epilepsy and developmental impairment. Cerebral visual impairment is neurologic and occurs in only 2/13.
Numerous hepatic cysts define the disease; renal cysts have unspecified frequency and do not establish common renal functional damage.
Hereditary spastic paraplegia classified as a phospholipid metabolism disorder. Muscle wasting is neurogenic; no separate common intrinsic muscle disease is established.
Usually phenotypically silent. Listed organ phenotypes reflect separately unmasked recessive disorders rather than direct effects of paternal chromosome 1 disomy.
Inherited albumin synthesis defect with hyperlipidemia; lipodystrophy affects subcutis in 30-79%. Respiratory infections and osteoporosis are separate conditions.
EBV-associated lymphoid proliferation predominantly involves lungs; cutaneous infiltration occurs in roughly 30-50% and CNS involvement in about 30%.
The named defining malformations affect the esophagus, eye through coloboma, and feet through talipes; no additional phenotype information is supplied.
Congenital interruption of sympathetic innervation causes defining pupillary dysfunction and eyelid ptosis; facial anhidrosis does not establish skin damage.
Staphylococcal infection directly inflames and damages an intervertebral disc.
Glycosylation disorder affecting neuromuscular transmission; intrinsic muscle pathology and knee contractures in 3/5 support musculoskeletal involvement.
Benign neoplasm arising from cutaneous hair follicles.
VCP-related motor neuron degeneration and/or frontotemporal dementia. Weakness and denervation do not establish a separate intrinsic muscle disorder.
Umbrella for inherited auditory system disorders; additional organ disease is subtype-specific.
Epidermal nevi define disease; spinal cord atrophy/compression and spinal canal stenosis are each reported in 30-79%. Ocular and renal abnormalities are below 30%.
Immune deficiency with chronic Candida infection of skin, nails and oral mucosa; these sites define the syndrome. Other listed organ involvement is below 30%.
Combined immunodeficiency with neutropenia and lymphopenia in 5/5; eczematoid dermatitis occurs in 3/5. Diarrhea alone does not establish intestinal damage.
Encephalomyopathic mitochondrial depletion with lactic acidosis defines metabolic, brain and muscle disease. Isolated renal or immune reports do not establish common involvement.
Connective-tissue neoplasm umbrella includes bone, cartilage and fibrous lineages. Histologic composition does not establish a particular visceral site or additional organ involvement.
Inherited dystrophic degeneration of skeletal muscle; cardiac and respiratory involvement varies across dominant subtypes and is not established for most of the umbrella.
Malignant tumor occupies the colon by definition; the primary tumor site is unspecified.
Pathologic dilation and tortuosity of veins define a vascular disorder; no other organ is consistently damaged across the umbrella.
